3. As could be seen from the above, apart from there being a vague assertion that the petitioner Nos.2 & 5 along with accused Nos.3 & 4 had instigated the first accused, who was the husband of the complainant, to demand dowry, there is no other specific overt acts alleged against them.

4. It is also stated that this court, in Crl.P. No.100071/2021 has in fact quashed the proceedings as against accused Nos.3 & 4 on the ground that there were only omnibus allegations against the accused Nos.3 & 4, and the continuation of the proceedings against them would be an abuse of the process of law.

5. In my view, on the same analogy and on the same principle, the proceedings against accused Nos.2 & 5 NC: 2024:KHC-D:875 also deserves to be quashed as only general allegations are made against them.
6. Accordingly, the proceedings against accused Nos.2 & 3 are quashed.
7. The proceedings shall however go on only against the accused No.1, husband, since there are specific allegations made against him.
The petition is accordingly allowed in part.
